notes: CR 400.7: an object that moves from one zone to another becomes a new object. Shock waits on the stack aimed at the Ox; the Ox is exiled and returned in response, so the Ox now on the battlefield is a new object that Shock never targeted. Its only target is illegal at resolution and it does nothing (CR 608.2b): the Ox takes no damage. flicker_spell_target_control is the same without the flicker.
